sprayLedSetup.title: LED setup
sprayLedSetup.patternHint: Choose how the mounting holes are arranged on your Spraywall.
sprayLedSetup.offsetTitle: How does the top row start?
sprayLedSetup.offsetHint: Choose the arrangement of the top row. Every other row is shifted by half a column.
sprayLedSetup.alignTitle: Match the holes to your Spraywall image
sprayLedSetup.gridHint: Drag the four rings onto the outermost T-nut holes: top left, top right, bottom left and bottom right.
sprayLedSetup.offsetAlignHint: Imagine a complete grid around the holes. Place the four rings at its outer corners. Where an inset row leaves a corner empty, place the ring where that missing hole would be. The dots show the actual staggered holes.
sprayLedSetup.countHint: Count every distinct vertical hole position, including inset rows: 8 + 7 positions are 15 columns.
sprayLedSetup.countRange: Use whole numbers: 1–50 rows and 1–{{max}} columns.
sprayLedSetup.invalidCorners: Move the marked points so they describe a valid row, column or area.
sprayLedSetup.singleRowHint: Move the two upper points to the first and last T-nut holes in the row.
sprayLedSetup.singleOffsetRowHint: Place the two upper points at the first and last vertical positions of the complete grid. If this row has no hole at an end, imagine one there. The dots show where the actual holes should line up.
sprayLedSetup.singleColumnHint: Move the two left points to the first and last T-nut holes in the column.
sprayLedSetup.singlePointHint: Move the point onto the T-nut hole.
sprayLedSetup.zoomHint: Pinch to zoom. Drag the image to move it.
sprayLedSetup.customHint: Choose Add, Move or Remove, then edit the mounting holes on the photo.
sprayLedSetup.refineHint: Check the generated holes. Choose Add, Move or Remove to correct their positions.
sprayLedSetup.holeLimit: You can mark up to 3,000 holes.
sprayLedSetup.needHole: Add at least one hole to continue.
sprayLedSetup.loadFailed: Your Spraywall photo or saved setup could not be loaded.
sprayLedSetup.saveFailed: Your setup could not be saved. Try again.
sprayLedSetup.localHint: Saved to this Spraywall. Climbers here can light it from their own phones.
sprayLedSetup.photoChanged: The Spraywall photo has changed. Match the holes to the new photo; your previous setup stays saved until you continue.
sprayLedSetup.ledHint: Choose where the LEDs sit relative to each hold.
sprayLedSetup.ledAlternatingHint: LEDs fill the gaps in each row of the offset grid, alternating with the holds.
sprayLedSetup.discardBody: Your changes have not been saved yet.
sprayLedSetup.clearCableBody: Adding or removing an LED clears your cable path and skipped LED counts. You will need to wire the LEDs again.
sprayLedSetup.rebuildLedsBody: Your holes or LED pattern changed. Starting over replaces your LED positions and clears your cable path and the holds you linked by hand.
sprayLedSetup.photoLabel: Rectified Spraywall photo with T-nut positions
sprayLedSetup.unavailable: This Spraywall is unavailable or you cannot edit it.
sprayLedSetup.regenerateHint: Changing the grid replaces your manual hole adjustments when you continue.
sprayLedSetup.editLedsHint: Choose Add, Move or Remove before editing the LEDs.
sprayLedSetup.editLedsBelowHint: With “Below the hold”, the LEDs initially sit half a spacing below the holes.
sprayLedSetup.pairLedsHint: Tap two LEDs to make them one unit behind a hold, or tap a pair to separate it.
sprayLedSetup.pairLedsSecond: Now tap the LED to pair it with.
sprayLedSetup.legendPairs: Orange: mounting holes. Purple: LEDs. Interlocking rings: two LEDs behind one hold, moved and wired as one.
sprayLedSetup.cablePatternHint: One continuous cable runs from LED to LED. Choose a starting pattern or draw your own.
sprayLedSetup.cableStartHint: Choose the corner with the first LED on the cable.
sprayLedSetup.cableEditorHint: Choose Lay cable, then tap LEDs or drag across them to extend the current cable end. Use two fingers to move or zoom the image.
sprayLedSetup.lightAndTapHint: LED {{index}} is lit on your Spraywall. Tap where it is in the photo.
sprayLedSetup.lightAndTapEnd: That was the last LED on the strip. Every LED the controller has is assigned or skipped.
sprayLedSetup.wiringHint: Select two LEDs to join free ends or cut their connection. Skipped LEDs come on the next step.
sprayLedSetup.cableComplete: Every LED is on the cable. To change its route, cut a connection with “Select two LEDs”.
sprayLedSetup.skipsHint: If the strip has LEDs that are not on your Spraywall, for example where it runs between rows, tap that connection on the cable and set how many it skips. Light the ends to check the two LEDs on either side.
sprayLedSetup.skipsNoConnection: Tap a connection on the cable.
sprayLedSetup.skipsNone: No skipped LEDs on this connection
sprayLedSetup.initialSkipHint: Enter how many LEDs come before the first marked position. With 0, that position starts at LED index 0.
sprayLedSetup.initialSkipLabel: LEDs to skip at the cable start
sprayLedSetup.skipCountRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.
sprayLedSetup.wiringLegend: Purple: LEDs. Turquoise: the cable; arrows show its direction. Green ring: where it starts. Turquoise ring: where it ends. Small dots on the cable: skipped LEDs. Red ring: loose end to connect. Faint orange: holes.
sprayLedSetup.holdLedsHint: Check which LEDs belong to each hold before laying the cable. Tap a hold to see its LEDs; if they are wrong, tap LEDs to add them to the hold or take them away. Holds outlined in red have no LED. LEDs with a red ring have no hold.
sprayLedSetup.holdLedsNotWired: The Spraywall lights the chosen hold once the cable is laid. Come back to this step after the cable to check it on the Spraywall.
sprayLedSetup.holdLedsFreeLedSelected: This LED has no hold. Tap the hold it belongs to.
sprayLedSetup.holdLedsSelectedManual: LEDs on this hold (chosen by hand): {{count}}
sprayLedSetup.holdLedsNoHold: Tap a hold on the photo.
sprayLedSetup.holdLedsLedHint: Tap an LED to add it to this hold or take it away. Tap away from the LEDs to pick another hold.
sprayLedSetup.lightingHint: Light all LEDs or run a quick test row by row from the top left. Each row starts on the left.
sprayLedSetup.mappingHint: Choose holes or holds, then tap the photo to select them. Their LEDs light up straight away. Tap again to deselect. Red dashed outlines have no LED.
sprayLedSetup.allLitSummary: All LEDs lit · {{count}} on the photo
sprayLedSetup.lightingUnavailable: Enable LEDs and save a WLED address.
